name: Abby Normalli in Mayhem Mansion
detailed_description:
Abby Normalli in Mayhem Mansion is a jazz-soaked 3D platformer bursting with razzmatazz, mischief, and cartoon calamity. Step into the shoes of a firecracker, with a flair for trouble and a hammer that hits harder than a speakeasy bouncer.

One dame. One hammer. One screwy inheritance.

You’re Abby Normalli, a swell gal with a love for hot tunes, heavy hitters, and poking her nose where it don’t belong. When your off-the-rails great-uncle kicks the bucket, he doesn’t leave a will—he leaves a scavenger hunt! Dig up the most family heirlooms stashed around his ritzy, trap-laden estate, and the whole inheritance is yours.

But keep your peepers peeled—your kooky kin are chasing the same prize, and they ain’t above playing dirty.

Big maps. Bigger moxie.

Every corner of the mansion is a new slice of nonsense, from haunted hideaways and busted labs to garden parties gone goofy. You’ll be solving puzzles, hopping platforms, dodging traps, and cracking wise the whole way through.

  • Swing big with Abby’s oversized hammer—perfect for smashing, bashing, and making an entrance

  • Roam wild through nonlinear 3D worlds packed with secrets, gags, and zany surprises

  • Put the squeeze on rival relatives as you work your way through a family tree full of nuts

  • Snag heirlooms to climb the inheritance ladder and prove you’ve got the goods

short_description: A jazz-fueled 3D platformer where you bash, bounce, and explore a sprawling cartoon mansion. Play as Abby Normalli, a mischief-loving whirlwind with a giant hammer, and compete to collect family heirlooms in chaotic, character-packed worlds.

English*, Spanish - Latin America

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX-2000 series or AMD RX-6000 series
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
